title: Enhanced residual risk of abamectin induced by 6PPD: in water, soil, and vegetables
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1013-1024
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00053J, Paper
Jiawen Ji, Siyue Zhu, Xinping Hu, Jianhui Zhu, Sen Pang, Yongqiang Ma, Xuefeng Li
6PPD significantly prolongs the photodegradation half-life of abamectin in water, soil, and vegetables by inhibiting oxidation, scavenging free radicals, and stabilizing the macrolide structure.
